plan.hypothesis: Strict SIMT verification admits each real Table 1 device object with a finite one-time verifier-call latency; randomized NO_VERIFY arms confirm the matched runtime/object path skips the verifier.
plan.pair_definition: For one tool and pair index, exactly one fresh STRICT process and one fresh NO_VERIFY process using the same built object, verifier-enabled runtime, llama-cli command, correctness oracle, and safety gates.
plan.a0_definition: one separate fresh STRICT admission/correctness cell per tool
